record.question: What camps, toilets, water sources and parking are available along the approach?
record.reason: Coverage includes historical trailhead facilities, Baker/Deadman/Cherry Valley campground reports, 45 individually reviewed Cherry Valley listing pages and Kennedy cabin inventory. Conflicting water/toilet/fee reports, omitted Cherry Valley site 001, individual Baker/Deadman sites, current availability, remote camps and facility connectors remain unresolved. Inventory is not a reservation or operating guarantee.
